explainer_content.short_definition: Slow breaks, dub bass, haunted samples, and late-night electronic atmosphere.
explainer_content.history_capsule: Trip-hop and downtempo emerged around Bristol and adjacent sample culture by slowing the dance impulse into mood, shadow, and groove.
explainer_content.why_it_mattered: It gave electronic music a cinematic, intimate, nocturnal vocabulary that crossed into alternative and pop listening.
explainer_content.what_made_it_distinct: The distinct feature is restraint: heavy feeling without festival impact, groove without rush.
